questions.title: An audit does not start on audit day. It starts with the questions you ask every week.
questions.lead: Anyone who works in compliance knows the scene: the document exists, but nobody remembers which control it proves. The answer is out there, scattered across spreadsheets, folders and chats. Every question turns into a search, an email or a meeting.

items.before: Open the control spreadsheet and hope it is up to date.
items.after: The evidence already sits inside the control it proves.

items.before: Check dates file by file, or find out on the day.
items.after: The renewal queue shows what has expired and what is about to.

how.title: Everything connected, from requirement to score.
how.p1: Each requirement of the standard becomes a control; each control has the evidence that proves it. When something is missing, the gap becomes an action with an owner and a deadline, and the score shows the effect.
how.p2: The journey has seven stages, each with an exit condition that the system itself checks. You do not find out the day before that an earlier phase was left incomplete.

about.quote: An audit should not mean a scramble. Yet for many companies it is exactly when missing documents, lost evidence, outdated controls and untracked risks come to light.
about.text: After living through this challenge first-hand, our founder created Audit Cockpits to help companies keep their compliance organized and ready for audits, not only when an audit arrives.

bids.title: Certification earns points and, when justified, can be required.
bids.text: Brazil's Federal Court of Accounts (TCU) accepts scoring certifications in technique-and-price tenders. The general rule is still not to restrict competition.

platform.title: Platform
platform.heroTitle: A command center for the entire compliance cycle
platform.heroText: From choosing a framework to the external auditor's report, ARS structures the whole process as a guided, continuous, measurable journey.

sections.title: Guided journey
sections.text: The guided diagnostic assesses your organization against the chosen framework and automatically generates the activity plan. No one starts from a blank screen: the platform always points to the highest-impact next step.

sections.title: Controls and SOA
sections.text: Each framework is structured into requirements and controls. Your organization declares each control's applicability in the Statement of Applicability, with a recorded justification for every exclusion, exactly what the auditor expects to find.

sections.title: Activities with owners and deadlines
sections.text: Every gap becomes an activity assigned to an owner, with a deadline and priority. A personal inbox for those who execute, a kanban board for those who coordinate. Notifications keep the process moving without manual chasing.

sections.title: Evidence with a lifecycle
sections.text: Upload, approval, rejection with mandatory justification, versioning, and controlled validity. When a document enters its expiration window, the platform reopens the activity for the owner, before the score drops.

sections.title: Continuous score and coverage
sections.text: The Audit Readiness Score is recalculated on every relevant change. Coverage is visible by framework, by area, and by control, with historical snapshots that show the trend, not just the snapshot.

sections.title: Audits end to end
sections.text: Internal audits with a defined scope, recorded findings, non-conformities with mandatory CAPA, and temporary access so the external auditor can verify everything directly on the platform.

score.title: Audit Readiness Score
score.heroTitle: One number that replaces months of uncertainty
score.heroText: The Audit Readiness Score expresses, from 0 to 100%, how ready your organization is for an external audit. It is not an estimate: it is a deterministic calculation any auditor can verify.
score.howText: The score is the weighted ratio between covered controls and applicable controls. Each control carries a weight defined by its criticality: a critical control weighs four times more than a low-criticality one. Controls declared not applicable in the SOA are excluded from the calculation. Controls blocked by a major non-conformity have their coverage zeroed until resolution.

bands.name: Not Auditable
bands.text: Critical gaps that would result in failure. The recommendation is not to schedule an external audit in this band.

bands.name: Moderate Risk
bands.text: A solid foundation with relevant gaps. An audit can be scheduled, with a calculated risk of non-conformities.

bands.name: Audit Ready
bands.text: Fit to receive an external audit with a reasonable expectation of approval. The internal process was run with rigor.

score.decayTitle: A score that can fall is a score you can trust
score.decayText: Evidence expires. Policies need renewal. When a document lapses and isn't renewed, the control loses coverage and the score falls automatically. A 90% score in September is not the same as a 90% score in March if nothing was updated. ARS is honest about that, because the auditor will be too.
score.trendText: The platform stores periodic snapshots of score and coverage. A 78% score on a consistent upward trend is worth more than 82% in decline, and the platform actively communicates that difference.

frameworks.heroText: Every framework is decomposed into requirements and controls, with search, filters, and category taxonomy. The structure is the same for any standard: only the normative content changes.

frameworks.catalogTitle: A catalog that grows with you
frameworks.catalogText: Beyond the anchor standards, the catalog includes frameworks for environment, occupational health and safety, medical devices, food safety, anti-bribery, and artificial intelligence, among others. Well-built evidence can serve more than one standard, and the platform was designed to run multiple frameworks simultaneously.

frameworks.multiText: ARS was designed from the ground up to operate several frameworks at once, with coverage calculated per standard and a consolidated view for leadership.

lgpd.title: LGPD
lgpd.heroTitle: LGPD compliance that withstands regulatory scrutiny
lgpd.heroText: The ARS LGPD module integrates personal data mapping into the same coverage model as every other framework, with the traceability that Brazil's ANPD and data subjects demand.

sections.title: ROPA: Records of Processing
sections.text: Map processing operations with legal bases, data categories, and data subject categories. The record Article 37 requires, always current.

sections.title: DPIA: Impact Reports
sections.text: Impact reports linked to high-risk operations, with history and versioning.

sections.title: Privacy incidents
sections.text: Record and track incidents with a complete trail, from report to resolution.

sections.title: Data subject rights
sections.text: Manage access, correction, deletion, and portability requests, each with a deadline and an owner.

lgpd.integratedTitle: Integrated with the rest of your compliance
lgpd.integratedText: LGPD doesn't live in a separate tool. Privacy evidence participates in the same coverage model, the same score, and the same audit trail, and a well-built data protection policy also contributes to ISO 27701.

audits.title: Audits
audits.heroTitle: From internal audit to external auditor, no improvised dossiers
audits.heroText: ARS structures the complete audit cycle: scope, execution, findings, non-conformities, and corrective action plans.

sections.title: Audits with a defined scope
sections.text: Record internal and external audits with a scope delimited by requirements and controls.

sections.title: Classified findings
sections.text: Conformity, non-conformity, observation, and improvement opportunity: every finding recorded with context and evidence.

sections.title: Mandatory NC and CAPA
sections.text: Every non-conformity requires a corrective action plan with an owner and a deadline. The system doesn't leave critical findings untreated.

sections.title: The external auditor's room
sections.text: Temporary, scoped access, 72 hours maximum, for the auditor to verify evidence, trails, and history directly on the platform.

audits.closing: When the certification date arrives, there is no last-minute scramble. There is an exported report and a score to show.

security.title: Security and Trust
security.heroTitle: A compliance platform must be exemplary at its own compliance
security.heroText: ARS's credibility with auditors depends on our own security discipline. And it is verifiable.

sections.title: Immutable audit trail
sections.text: Every relevant action creates an append-only record with chained hashes. History cannot be rewritten by anyone.

sections.title: Absolute per-organization isolation
sections.text: Each organization is an isolated tenant. No query crosses the boundary between organizations.

sections.title: Enterprise authentication
sections.text: Identity managed by an OIDC provider with role-based access control. No improvised passwords.

sections.title: Protected evidence
sections.text: Files stored in object storage with short-lived signed URLs. Nothing is publicly exposed.

sections.title: Privacy by design
sections.text: The platform practices the LGPD it helps implement: data minimization, consent, and defined retention.

solutions.title: Solutions
solutions.heroTitle: The same state of readiness, seen from the right seat
solutions.heroText: Compliance is a team sport. ARS gives each role exactly the view and the tools it needs.

profiles.pain: "Are we ready?" can't depend on a meeting with the consultancy.
profiles.value: A real-time score, historical trend, and reports ready for the board and the certification body.

profiles.pain: Spreadsheets, emails, and manual chasing don't scale, and leave no trace.
profiles.value: A single hub that assigns ownership, measures coverage by area, and generates the reports auditors ask for.

profiles.pain: An outdated ROPA and data subject requests in an inbox are regulatory risk.
profiles.value: A complete LGPD module, integrated into the same coverage model and the same audit trail.

profiles.pain: Urgent evidence requests on the eve of an audit interrupt the real work.
profiles.value: A dedicated activity queue, early expiration alerts, and clarity about what each control requires.

profiles.pain: Trainings and contracts expire silently, and take entire controls down with them.
profiles.value: Controlled renewal: the platform reopens the activity for the owner before the expiration date.

consultancies.title: For Consultancies
consultancies.heroTitle: Scale your consultancy without scaling your headcount
consultancies.heroText: Every client in a different spreadsheet is a growth ceiling. ARS puts all your clients in a single environment, fully isolated from each other.

sections.title: One environment, every client
sections.text: Multi-organization architecture with absolute data isolation. A centralized view for the consultancy, a dedicated environment for each client.

sections.title: Your methodology, embedded
sections.text: The platform's guided journey carries your methodology: diagnostic, plan, execution, and audit preparation, repeatable for every client.

sections.title: Reports that maintain themselves
sections.text: Score and coverage are recalculated continuously. The report you present to a client is never out of date.

sections.title: Traceability that protects you
sections.text: Every recommendation, approval, and delivery recorded in the audit trail. The consultancy demonstrates value with data, not perception.

about.title: About
about.heroTitle: Compliance is a capability, not a service delivered by inaccessible experts
paragraphs: There is a moment every growing company faces: the day an important client, a bank, or a strategic partner demands an ISO certificate or proof of data protection compliance, and the company realizes it has nothing structured.

Then a race begins that lasts months. A consultancy is hired, scattered documents are gathered in a hurry, spreadsheets no one can interpret pile up, and a dossier goes stale the day it's finished. After all that effort, there is a real chance of failing over details that basic organization would have prevented.
ARS exists to change that story. We believe compliance is a capability any organization can build, with clarity about what to do, continuity in the process, and predictability in the outcome.

The platform turns complex normative requirements into clear journeys, executable tasks, and measurable results. Organizations that adopt it don't prepare for an audit: they operate in a permanent state of readiness. When the auditor's date arrives, they open the platform, export the report, and show the score.
about.missionText: Make compliance accessible, continuous, and predictable for any organization, regardless of size, maturity, or budget.

principles.title: Score before status
principles.text: Numbers communicate more than labels. Where a label would say "in progress", ARS shows "67% covered".

principles.title: AI accelerates, humans decide
principles.text: Artificial intelligence removes busywork and suggests paths. The final decision is always human.

principles.title: Coverage is not declaration
principles.text: A control marked as implemented without approved evidence doesn't count. Reality matters more than intention.

principles.title: Traceability is not optional
principles.text: Every relevant action creates an immutable record. It is the foundation of trust with auditors.

principles.title: The score falls if nothing is done
principles.text: The platform is honest about decay. A high score doesn't maintain itself, and ARS doesn't pretend it does.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.heroTitle: The questions we hear most often

items.a: No. Documents exist in ARS only as evidence linked to normative controls. The point is not to store files: it is to demonstrate, with traceability, that every requirement of the standard is met.

items.q: How is ARS different from a well-organized spreadsheet?
items.a: A spreadsheet doesn't calculate criticality-weighted readiness, doesn't fall when evidence expires, doesn't reopen activities for owners, doesn't keep an immutable audit trail, and doesn't host the external auditor. ARS does all of that, continuously.

items.q: Do I need a compliance team to use the platform?
items.a: No. The guided journey was designed for teams that have never been through an audit: the diagnostic identifies the gaps and generates the activity plan. The language is business language, not standards jargon.

items.q: Does the AI make compliance decisions?
items.a: Never. ARS's AI analyzes gaps and prioritizes actions, but every decision to approve, reject, or declare applicability is human, and it is recorded in the audit trail.

items.q: Which standards does the platform cover?
items.a: The catalog has 30+ frameworks, with ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 22301, ISO 27701, and LGPD as anchor standards. The structure is multi-framework by default: several frameworks can run simultaneously.

items.q: How does the external auditor access the evidence?
items.a: Through temporary, scoped access, valid for a maximum of 72 hours, allowing the auditor to verify evidence, trails, and history directly on the platform, no dossiers on a USB stick.
